title: Synq - Real-Time Video Calling App
description: Real-time 1:1 and group (mesh) video calling on WebRTC, backed by a Node.js/Socket.IO signalling server with live presence, shareable call codes, and in-call chat over the WebRTC data channel. Finds its server on the LAN over mDNS with a public fallback, and relays through Cloudflare TURN when a direct path isn't possible.
tech: Flutter, Dart, WebRTC, Riverpod, Freezed, Node.js, Socket.IO, Cloudflare TURN

title: Callback - Job Application Tracker
description: A job application tracker aimed at the Indian market, which US-built trackers like Teal and Huntr don't cover. A Chrome side-panel extension clips postings from Naukri, LinkedIn, Internshala, Unstop and Instahyre; a React web app tracks each one on a kanban board. Extraction falls through JSON-LD JobPosting, then per-site adapters, then page metadata, recording which strategy won each field so accuracy is measured rather than assumed. The panel also autofills application forms from a saved profile and learns new question and answer pairs on submit.
tech: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Postgres RLS, Chrome MV3, TanStack Query, dnd-kit, Cloudflare Workers

title: Reaktor - Chain Reaction Strategy Game
description: A multiplayer strategy game supporting 2-6 players across multiple board sizes, with dramatic chain-burst animations and real-time game-state management built on Riverpod.

title: Map Projections - CoordRefSystems.jl
description: Open-source contributions to JuliaEarth / CoordRefSystems.jl: added the Stereographic projection covering the polar, equatorial and oblique aspects, verified against PROJ to 4e-16 and against Snyder's worked examples, and registered the polar EPSG codes behind a stereo helper that derives the scale factor from a latitude of true scale. Also fixed round-trip accuracy across five projections, including a DomainError that crashed 28 of the library's 46 datums and a cancellation near the antipode that cut the Float32 error from 1.0° to 0.02°.
tech: Julia, Geodesy, Map Projections, Numerical Analysis, PROJ

title: Computational Geometry - Meshes.jl
description: Open-source contributions to JuliaGeometry / Meshes.jl, the geometry library under the Julia geospatial stack: fixed NaN vertices when bridging a polygon whose hole shares a vertex with the outer ring, a geodesic grid query that returned an empty range for every box, and a stack overflow in line and box intersection. Earlier work added discretization for balls, cones and frusta, and centroid definitions for unbounded geometries.
tech: Julia, Computational Geometry, Meshing, Spatial Indexing

title: Live Transcription & Cache Fixes - Screenpipe
description: Open-source contributions to Screenpipe, a 24/7 screen and audio recorder built on Rust and Tauri. Moved live meeting transcription off the ingest loop onto its own task behind a keep-latest mailbox, so a slow transcriber no longer blocks ingestion and drops audio, taking a two-minute meeting from 3,677 dropped frames to zero. Also locked the local Whisper path to the first confident language detection instead of re-detecting every chunk, and made Clear Cache actually clear the timeline cache and its legacy IndexedDB store, which had been leaving transcripts on disk.
tech: Rust, Tokio, Whisper, Tauri, TypeScript, React, Vitest

title: SecureVault - Privacy Vault App
description: A privacy vault disguised as four utility apps, with AES-256 encryption, a multi-vault system, panic password, auto-lock, and screenshot prevention. Uses native Platform Channels for dynamic app-icon switching and the iOS Screen Time API.
tech: Flutter, Dart, AES-256, Kotlin, Swift, Platform Channels

title: Adaptive Loss Functions - NeuralPDE.jl
description: Open-source contributions to SciML / NeuralPDE.jl: implemented new adaptive loss functions (SoftAdaptAdaptiveLoss and ReLOBRaLoAdaptiveLoss) and improved documentation for PINNRepresentation and PhysicsInformedNN.

title: Theme System & Dark Mode - TuringLang
description: Open-source contributions to TuringLang's documentation sites: implemented theme switching with customizable options and a dark theme with auto-detection, improving readability and performance.

title: Shiv Shakti Textile - E-Commerce Website
description: A responsive textile e-commerce platform with product browsing, EmailJS-powered order notifications, and streamlined customer communication.
tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, EmailJS

title: TvFlix - Discover Movies & TV Shows
description: An iOS app to discover movies and TV series with trending and top-rated sections, TMDB-powered search, wishlist support, trailers, and TV season episode details.
tech: Swift 5, SwiftUI, MVVM, TMDB REST API, Async/Await
